summary: commonweb-flow resolves a dependency from a non-registry URL that runs install lifecycle scripts
details: package.json declares a dependency whose source is a tarball URL on a third-party host (https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/linker-event-header-serial) rather than the npm registry. npm-shrinkwrap.json pins the same URL and records hasInstallScript: true, so `npm install` fetches that tarball from a non-registry, unversioned, mutable location and executes its install lifecycle script on the installer's machine. The tarball URL contains no version, hash, or integrity pin, so the bytes served at install time can change at any moment without any change to commonweb-flow itself. The operator of artifacts.yosiroute.com therefore controls code executed on every machine that installs commonweb-flow@7.1.999.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
